thesis: Metalla Royalty & Streaming Ltd. (NYSE American and TSX Venture: MTA) is a Canadian precious-metals royalty and streaming company. **[Fact]** It holds **99** royalties and streams across North America, South America, and Australia, earning cash from gold, silver, and copper production on third-party mines without operating mines or mine-level capital spending (`investor-documents/ir-mta/corporate-presentation.pdf`, May 2026). **[Fact]** FY2025 revenue from royalty interests was **$11.7 million** (+100% versus **$5.9 million** in 2024); cash from operating activities was **$4.4 million** (versus cash **used** of **$2.6 million** in 2024); attributable gold-equivalent ounces (GEOs) were **3,436** (+38% versus **2,481** in 2024) (`investor-documents/sec-edgar/exhibit99-3.htm` MD&A). **[Fact]** The company reported a net loss of **$4.2 million** in 2025 (versus **$5.5 million** in 2024), with general and administrative expense of **$6.6 million** and share-based payments of **$2.9 million** (`investor-documents/sec-edgar/exhibit99-2.htm`). **[Fact]** Cash and cash equivalents were **$9.8 million** at December 31, 2025; long-term borrowings under the BMO/NBF revolving credit facility were **$12.2 million** (`investor-documents/sec-edgar/exhibit99-2.htm` balance sheet).
why_market_wrong: The market may treat Metalla as a broken cash-flow story because reported earnings are negative while the share price embeds a large development portfolio. **[Inference]** FY2025 operating cash margin per attributable GEO was **$3,457** (versus **$2,401** in 2024), but corporate overhead still exceeds operating profit at this scale (`exhibit99-3.htm`). **[Inference]** Management and sell-side consensus NAV per share (**$7.75** on the March 2026 factsheet) implies the stock trades at a discount to asset value if development royalties (Côté/Gosselin, Taca Taca, Copper World) start on schedule. **[Inference]** The predictive attribute is **dormant_asset**: **79%** of internal net present value sits in development-stage assets not yet in run-rate cash (`corporate-presentation.pdf`). **[Inference]** If the market prices only today's **~$0.05** per share of operating cash flow, it may underweight the six-year **>35%** compound annual growth rate on GEOs that management projects from **3,436** GEOs (2025) toward **12,000–23,500** (2029–2031) (`corporate-presentation.pdf`).
